summary: PSB Financial, Inc., the proposed holding company for Pioneer State Bank, filed an 8-K announcing the upcoming close of its mutual-to-stock conversion and related initial public offering. The subscription offering was oversubscribed by eligible account holders, with 1,719,250 shares sold at $10.00 per share (including 137,540 shares to an ESOP). The conversion closes May 21, 2026, with OTCQB listing expected May 22, 2026. The filing details a rights offering structure where existing depositors had first priority. No advisor, board recommendation, or premium is stated. Watch for regulatory approval timing and post-conversion trading liquidity.
